LanguageData.CH_Building_WashTub_Desc: A wooden tub for scrubbing clothes by hand. Anyone can use it without research, but it is slow and no substitute for a proper laundry basin.
LanguageData.CH_Building_LaundryBasin_Desc: A proper basin with a scrubbing board and room to soak several garments. Faster than a hand tub and easier on the fabric.
LanguageData.CH_Building_WashingMachine_Desc: An electric drum washer. It washes one dirty garment every cycle on its own as long as it has power, water and soap. Leave dirty clothes next to it.
LanguageData.CH_Building_UltraSonicWasher_Desc: A sonic cleaning tank that shakes dirt out of fabric without scrubbing. Uses half the water and half the soap of a drum washer, and finishes in half the time.
LanguageData.CH_Item_Soap_Desc: A bar of harsh lye soap. Washing a garment with soap lifts the dirt out completely; without it, some grime always stays behind.
LanguageData.CH_Recipe_MakeSoap_Desc: Boil wood ash with cloth scraps and pour the result into bars of harsh soap.
LanguageData.CH_Research_Basin_Desc: Build a proper laundry basin with a scrubbing board, so garments can be soaked and washed faster than in a hand tub.
LanguageData.CH_Research_Soap_Desc: Render wood ash and cloth scraps into bars of soap. Soap lifts grease out of fabric, so a washed garment comes out completely clean instead of merely less dirty.
LanguageData.CH_Research_Washer_Desc: An electric drum washer that scrubs a garment on its own, cycle after cycle, as long as it has power, water and soap. Requires electricity.
LanguageData.CH_Research_UltraSonic_Desc: Sonic agitation strips dirt out of fabric without scrubbing. An ultrasonic washer uses half the water and half the soap, and finishes each load in half the time.
LanguageData.CH_NeedWaterAdjacent: Must be placed next to water.
